seo.title: Case Studies | M20 Technology
seo.description: See how M20 Technology helps teams transform Confluence intranets and turn Jira data into secure executive dashboards.

studies.title: Outdated Intranet to Cutting-Edge Collaboration Hub
studies.summary: How M20 transformed a legacy intranet into a design-forward collaboration platform — with zero disruption to existing Confluence content.
studies.coverAlt: A dated, table-heavy intranet page fades behind a modern, branded collaboration hub with cards, an events calendar and search analytics.

studies.title: From Prototype to Production-Ready Executive Dashboard
studies.summary: How M20 turned a real-time Jira visibility need into a secure, production-grade executive dashboard.
studies.coverAlt: Project data flows from Jira through a security check into an executive dashboard with a status table, a RAG chart and upcoming milestones.
